reason: We only just moved off E-Golf4U, our volunteers are exhausted and the members have barely got used to the new system. Even a free pilot means another round of explaining, inviting and supporting, and I can't sell that to the board this year.
objection: Nothing in this tells me it links to the NGF handicap system or runs our direct debit collection. Without those it's a second system next to the one we have, not a replacement, and two founders is a thin team for a club of 950 members.
would_change_my_mind: Written confirmation that it works with the NGF handicap and our direct debit, and a call with the Golfclub Zwolle board after they've been live for a full season. Then I'd look again at our next contract renewal.
